sections.text:
# Hickory Grove Christian School — Sports (Redesign Research 2026)

- **School:** Hickory Grove Christian School, 7200 E. WT Harris Blvd., Charlotte, NC 28215.
 Founded 1995 (a ministry of Hickory Grove Baptist Church). NCISAA **3A** (joined NCISAA 2002),
 Metrolina Athletic Conference (MAC). Mascot **Lions**. Colors navy & gold.
 Athletic Director **Jim Rhodes**; Assistant AD **Crystal Rhodes**.

**Three brief-supplied "known facts" were CORRECTED / refined by primary sources:**
1. **Baseball 2023 IS a title, per the school's own Records & Titles page** — it lists
 Baseball NCISAA 3A Champions **2021 AND 2023** (plus 2005 2A). The 2024 result was
 **runner-up** (swept by Grace Christian of Sanford). So: champs 2021 & 2023, runner-up 2024.
2. **The UNCW commit is "Davis Cabbage," not "David Cabbage"** — HighSchoolOT's NC baseball
 recruiting tracker lists **Davis Cabbage → UNC Wilmington** (Class of 2025). Use "Davis."
3. **Boys Track title is NCISAA D2 (Division II), 2025** — HighSchoolOT: HGCS won the NCISAA
 **D2** boys track & field championship with **130 points** (37 over Asheville School's 93).
 The brief's "D2 champ 2025" is correct; recording the point margin for the record.

**Team state championships (school's Records & Titles page, S3):**
- **Baseball — NCISAA 3A Champions 2023**
- **Baseball — NCISAA 3A Champions 2021**
- **Baseball — NCISAA 2A Champions 2005**
- **Softball — NCISAA 3A Champions 2019, 2017, 2010, 2009, 2008, 2007, 2006** (a dominant run)
- **Women's Basketball — NCISAA 3A Champions 2009**
- **Boys Track & Field — NCISAA Division II Champions 2025** (S6; 130 pts, +37 over Asheville School)

**Runner-up finishes (S3):**
- Baseball — NCISAA 2024 3A **Runner-Up** (swept by Grace Christian of Sanford; G1 4-1, G2 7-5;
 HGCS finished 18-10 — S5)
- Softball — 3A Runners-Up 2018, 2015, 2013; 2A Runner-Up 2004
- Women's Basketball — 3A Runner-Up 2010
- Swimming — 2A Boys Runners-Up 2005

**Individual state champions (S3):**
- Men's Golf — NCISAA 3A Individual Champion **Chad Cox** (2009 & 2010)
- Cross Country — NCISAA 3A Men's Individual Champion **Daniel Similton** (2019); Boys Individual Champion (2018)
- Track & Field — multiple individual/relay state champions 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025

**Program totals (Wikipedia, S8):** since joining NCISAA in 2002 — 57 state playoff appearances,
22 state Final Fours, **7 state championships**, 5 state runner-ups, 2 individual state
championships, 48 regular-season/conference-tournament championships in the MAC.

**Datable title scores:** the 2024 runner-up scores are documented (S5). The 2021 & 2023
baseball championship final opponents/scores were NOT confirmed on a primary page during this
sweep (the NCISAA archive page fetched was the 2022 bracket, S10) — recorded as NOT FOUND for
exact score; the titles themselves are confirmed by the school (S3).

sections.text:
Each profile event claim was checked against the NCISAA's own published meet results. The
results PDFs were downloaded and read with `pdftotext -layout`. Athletes are not named here
or on the page.

| Claim | NCISAA source | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 2025 men's 4x200 relay | 2025 D2 meet report, event #19 — https://admin.ncisaa.org/uploads/Docs/NCISAA%20D2%20FInal%20Results.pdf | **confirmed**: 1st, Hickory Grove Christian (A), 1:32.36, 10 pts |
| 2025 men's 4x800 relay | same PDF, event #23 | **confirmed**: 1st, 8:05.86, 10 pts |
| 2025 men's 4x400 relay | same PDF, event #21 | **confirmed**: 1st, 3:27.28, 10 pts (Asheville School 2nd, 3:29.25) |
| 2025 D2 men's team title | same PDF, Boys Scores | **confirmed** (already on the page): 1st, 130 pts; Asheville School 93 |
| 2021 men's 400 m | 2021 D2 meet report (Forsyth Country Day, May 15, 2021), event #5 — https://admin.ncisaa.org/uploads/NCISAA%20D2%20Results.pdf, linked from https://archives.ncisaa.org/index.php?sport=22&years=2020-2021 | **confirmed**: 1st, Hickory Grove Christ[ian], 50.35, 10 pts |
| 2024 men's 4x400 relay | https://archives.ncisaa.org/index.php?sport=22&years=2023-2024 | **not found**: the page links no results, only an apparel store (nwd.ink, now 404). No 2024 track results upload appears in the Wayback CDX for `admin.ncisaa.org/uploads/`, and the 2024-09-11 capture of `ncisaa.org/playoff-brackets/?sport=22` links none either |
| 2023 men's 4x100 relay | https://archives.ncisaa.org/index.php?sport=22&years=2022-2023 | **not found**: the page links only a meet program (flipsnack) and the same apparel store; the May and June 2023 captures of the live bracket page link no results; the one 2022–23 track upload in the CDX is the sport-information rules sheet |

Note: the 2021 Division 3 PDF also mentions "Hickory Christian Academy". That is a different
school and was not counted.

**Outcome for the page:** the Boys Track & Field record row names the 2025 4x200, 4x800 and
4x400 relays and the 2021 400 m. The 2024 4x400 and 2023 4x100 are left off, because the
NCISAA has no published result to check them against. They remain the school's own claim,
recorded above. The team-title count stays 12.

HGCS hits:
- Baseball: Barozzino (2024, Division I, Appalachian State), Vanhook (Junior College,
 Gaston College), Cabbage and Green (2025, Division I).
- Football, Class of 2024 in-state: Dukes (cornerback, Division I FCS). The college
 headings on that page are logos, so the college comes from NCCU's roster.

There are no HGCS hits in the basketball, soccer, softball, volleyball, track, swimming,
tennis, golf or wrestling trackers, and none in any Class of 2026 list.

**RealGM** (Chrome): https://basketball.realgm.com/highschool/teams/7170/Hickory-Grove-Christian-School-NC/players.
One player in window: Zavien Dillingham (2024, Valley Forge), ruled out. 2025 and 2026
graduates: none listed.

**The Baseball Cube** (Chrome; 403 to curl): https://thebaseballcube.com/content/hs_team/11709/.
In window: Barozzino (App State), Green (UNC Asheville), Johnson (Wingate). Seven older
alumni (Class of 2023 and earlier) are excluded.

**College rosters checked (graduate test):** Appalachian State baseball (Barozzino bio),
NCCU football (Dukes bio), UNC Wilmington baseball (Cabbage), UNC Asheville baseball
(Green), Wingate baseball current and 2025 (Johnson), ETSU baseball current and 2025
(Johnson absent), Mars Hill 2026 Baseball Night program (Pelow; the athletics roster URL
404s), Gaston College baseball 2024-25 and 2025-26 (Vanhook).

**Other sources:** Prep Baseball Report 2024 HGCS preview and 2025 NC preview (search
snippets; the pages 403). PBR's 2026 Region 6 preview lists HGCS with no commitment shown.
An NCSA profile for Anthony Hawkins Jr. shows no commitment.
